name: ccprogress
description: A progress bar of the current task above the spinner, in the terminal and the Desktop app

stuck_minutes.title: Stuck alert (minutes)
stuck_minutes.description: Warn when the current step has run this long without moving on. 0 turns the alert off.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: toast: alerts inside the session only. system: also a desktop notification (osascript on macOS, notify-send on Linux).

fold_reports.title: Fold progress reports
fold_reports.description: In the terminal, show each progress report as one dim line instead of the whole step list.

language.title: Label language
language.description: Language of the bar's labels. auto follows the language of the steps.
